summary: Backend-only regression + new endpoint testing for Mazigho (Node/Express/tRPC on :3100). Verified admin auth, public catalog, admin dashboard stats, new Odoo status/verify endpoints, and CJ Dropshipping graceful degradation when keys are absent. All 9 pytest tests passed. No 500s, no server crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.log shows a pre-existing '[OAuth] ERROR: OAUTH_SERVER_URL is not configured!' warning — unrelated to this task but worth setting OAUTH_SERVER_URL in production env if OAuth is used.
Graceful-degradation pattern for Odoo (returns {configured:false,...}) and CJ (returns tRPC PRECONDITION_FAILED) is implemented correctly — endpoints never throw 500 when keys are absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a standalone Node/Express/tRPC app running as `node server-dist/index.js` on port 3100 (NOT the FastAPI template). Do not use supervisor. tRPC batching: queries via GET ?batch=1&input=<urlencoded {"0":{"json":...}}>, mutations via POST /api/trpc/<proc>?batch=1 with body {"0":{"json":...}}. Successful body: [{result:{data:{json:...}}}]; handled error: [{error:{json:{data:{code:'...'}}}}]. Odoo and CJ third-party success paths cannot be tested locally (no keys). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_mazigho_backend.py — reusable regression suite.
verified_endpoints: GET  http://localhost:3100/ (200 after all calls — server healthy)
